verdicts.reason: Both use the same broken background. The image is upscaled and soft, and the dark overlay covers only a horizontal band, so the top and bottom strips show bright, busy, undarkened photo with hard seams. In the original the whole image was evenly toned. A's frame and title keep a presence closer to the original and the text reads better, but the frame almost touches the band's top and bottom edges, which looks cramped and accidental. B's frame sits more comfortably inside the band, but the frame, logo and 'WOOD INDUSTRY CANADA' are shrunk, so the brand lockup feels weak on the larger canvas.
